propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui omnia pro te in hoc saeculo relinquentibus, centuplum in futuro et
vitam aeternam promisisti: concede propitius; ut, sancti Pontificis Paulini
vestigiis inhaerentes, valeamus terrena despicere, et sola caelestia
desiderare: Qui vivis et regnas.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

translations.text: O God, Who hast promised to those who leave all in this world for Thee a hundred-fold in the world to come and life everlasting, mercifully grant that, following closely in the footsteps of the holy bishop, Paulinus, we may have the grace to despise earthly things and desire only heavenly. Who livest.

propers.text:
Tribue nobis per haec sancta, Domine, illum pietatis et humilitatis
affectum, quem ex hoc divino fonte hausit sanctus Pontifex tuus Paulinus:
et, ipsius intercessione, in omnes, qui te deprecantur, gratiae tuae
divitias benignus effunde. Per Dominum.
